Through our unique and groundbreaking annual Startup Competition model, we provide up to $100,000 in equity-free grants and access to an ecosystem of resources, helping early-stage startups grow and scale.
These believers and builders are at the core of what Arch Grants stands for: the unwavering spirit of big ideas and a community that rallies behind the entrepreneurs who pursue them.

Accelerating Economic Development Arch Grants Companies have gone on to create more than 4,000 jobs in Missouri, generate over $1.2 billion in revenue, and attract more than $870 million in follow-on capital.
Louis community welcomes Arch Grants Founders into a robust ecosystem of support, resources, and talent that nurtures and empowers these leaders to thrive as their companies grow and scale.
Each one has a vision to change the world, and Arch Grants is committed to helping them to succeed.
